title: 1 December 1964: Ringo Starr goes into hospital
content:
Ringo Starr began his 10-day stay at University College Hospital, London on 1 December 1964. He was booked in to have his tonsils removed, an operation which took place the following day.

Prior to his arrival on the ward, Starr gave a brief press conference to assembled reporters.

Page last updated: 8 February 2023
